features.title: Full Protein Tracker app
features.detail: Dedicated page at /protein with auth gate, protein ring, macro bars, and meal log.

features.title: Camera and gallery food scan
features.detail: Scan meals via camera or upload; pick breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snack before analysing.

features.title: AI protein analysis edge function
features.detail: analyze-food-protein Supabase function with food-database cross-validation and confidence scoring.

features.title: Confirm-before-log modal
features.detail: Review and edit protein, calories, carbs, and fat before a meal is saved.

features.title: Gamification layer
features.detail: XP, levels, streaks, badges, and a seven-day protein heatmap with goal confetti.

features.title: Freemium scan limits and paywall
features.detail: Three free scans per day; Stripe checkout via create-protein-checkout for unlimited premium.

features.title: Settings and dark mode
features.detail: Settings sheet for protein goal, theme toggle, subscription plans, and sign-out.

features.title: Payment details in settings
features.detail: Settings now shows plan, price, billing status, renewal date, Stripe manage billing, and upgrade checkout.

features.title: Supabase protein schema
features.detail: Migration for protein_profiles, protein_meal_logs, scan feedback, and founder unlimited scans.
